answer: Make every new agent lock a refundable bond that vests only across many epochs, released like a slow-burning ember, not a bright comet. Honest agents reclaim it in full; a sybil fleet must freeze a separate bond per identity for the entire vesting window, so each clone is as costly to carve as solid ivory: N identities mean N times the capital and N times the lock-up time, and any early exit forfeits the stake. The cap on the attack is the opportunity cost of that frozen collateral, scaling linearly per identity.
